title: Rising Son - Everyone Should Have a Home / Everyone Dub

lines.l: I roam by the house with the windows lighted up
It's the prettiest gates I ever see
As I rode by myself, I just said to myself, everyone should have a hope, but some have not.
I rode by the douse, with the moon upon a coach, and the birds across the lover's knees.
As I go by myself, I just say to myself
Everyone should have a home for some of the night
When I looked up and saw
Yes, the road was dark and cold
And the air that I could not see
If the windows light it up, it's the Bridges' game.
